name: acqai
description: Ask ACQ AI (Mozi) from Claude Code with your own docs as the context: Claude writes the question, sends it through your own signed-in browser on your yes, pushes back on the answer, and brings the mechanics home with the edits they imply.

mozi_company.title: Your company on ACQ AI
mozi_company.description: The company name ACQ AI shows on its sign-in list, when you belong to more than one. The plugin reads it as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_MOZI_COMPANY. Leave it blank to click it yourself the first time, or set it later with: acqai.py setup --company "Your Company".
